posts.title: Objections to Desirism: Circularity
posts.description: This post looks at the objection that the assessment of desires (and of everybody based on their relationship to desires) is circular. Desire A is evaluated in virtue of its being such as to satisfy Desire B, which is evaluated in virtue of its being such as to satisfy Desire A. The circularity is there, but it provides no reason to reject desirism.
